title: Formula for Rotational Kinetic Energy
text: Use the formula for rotational kinetic energy, $$KE=\tfrac12I\omega**2.$$ First find the moment of inertia, then use it to find $$KE$$.

title: Moment of Inertia
text: The moment of inertia of the merry-go-round (a disk) and the child is $$I=\tfrac12Mr**2+m_{c}r_{c}**2,$$ where $$r_{c}$$ is the child's distance from the axis. Remember to convert the angular velocity to radians per second.
